kind: ADDITIVE and IMMUTABLE. Protocol for the 35D-masked branch. It SUPERSEDES the 25D branch, which was never executed and is quarantined by v26b_addendum_a0a1_superseded.json
execution_status: NOTHING EXECUTED. Protocol, tooling, tests and preflight only. No fit, training, rollout, collection or materialised candidate

architecture.final_student: 35D FROM CREATION. One contract, one manifest, one feature list: the v3 canonical 35D contract, unmodified
architecture.single_runtime_pin: runtime config a870cc38a77d853bbd5fba86b51cfcc3ef20a33a5823f4a42f1b968ba4a537db and manifest c6f8602816059b5c3508c626e5ce08d3ba922710f8b48c9557af9056f1155004. No second observation contract exists
architecture.base_phase: the ten controller/Markov features stay in the vector and in the manifest but are neutralised twice: an INPUT HARD MASK sets those observation columns to 0.0, and the corresponding first-layer columns are exactly zero, frozen, and restored to zero after every optimizer step
architecture.why_two_guarantees: they are independent and cover different failure modes. The input mask alone secures functional equivalence with the 25D subspace, because a leaking column multiplies a zero input. The zero columns alone secure the bit-exact unmask transition. A leak in either mechanism is detected by the other's test
architecture.markov_phase: only after the base gates pass: remove the mask and adapt. Because the columns are still exactly zero at that moment, the transition is BIT-EXACT by construction: no contract switch, no re-export, no second manifest

masked_channel.derivation: by NAME from the pinned 35D manifest, then checked against the expected tuple; a tampered expectation fails closed
masked_channel.clock_rule: the two clock columns stay present in the vector and their first-layer columns stay zero. The actor never receives the gait clock
masked_channel.contralateral: no contralateral feature exists in the 35D actor manifest

lineage_exclusive.parent_B0: EXCLUSIVELY the August V26 imitation actor 39D, digest 5bbc6cbd3c7e3ec37524b7b6b69ca017af48057cac5207cf755d3b2f72c2709e
lineage_exclusive.july: METHOD ONLY. No July checkpoint, dataset, label or anchor
lineage_exclusive.superseded_25d_branch: never imported, never executed, never used to produce any artifact

B0_transplant.recipe: the frozen V1 39->35 transplant reproduced from V26 (healthy targets mean-compensated, clock columns zeroed, hidden layer and mean head copied bit-identically), then the ten controller first-layer columns set to exactly zero

mean_compensation_rule.healthy_targets: COMPENSATED. Those four columns leave the vector for good, so their anchor mean is folded into the bias, exactly as the frozen V1 recipe does
mean_compensation_rule.controller_columns: NOT COMPENSATED, deliberately. They stay in the vector and return in the Markov phase; folding their mean into the bias would pre-load a constant the adaptation would have to unlearn. The July expansion started from a clean zero for the same reason

verifications: parent digest equal to the pin
the 39->35 recipe reproduces its own pinned digest ae846220...
every kept first-layer column bit-identical to that recipe
every other tensor bit-identical to that recipe
masked and clock columns exactly zero

B1_base_fit.parent: the B0 masked state, and nothing else

dataset.source: the three PINNED V26 anchor trajectories A_ISO39CLK_V3 - nominal, -0.20 s, +0.20 s - 500 rows each
dataset.labels: prescribed AB06 u_IK at the anchor's own times, EXACT float lookup on the pinned privileged caches; no interpolation
dataset.note: no new collection is required, and no S0D/S1A/REV4*/V2_* row enters

split.rationale: consecutive steps of one trajectory are strongly dependent; a random split leaks the neighbours of every held-out row into training

per_optimizer_step_protocol: mask the input batch on the ten columns
zero the gradient on the masked and clock first-layer columns (defensive: with masked inputs it is already identically zero)
restore the masked and clock first-layer columns to exactly zero
assert_no_masked_update: bit-identical AND still exactly zero
binding_offline_gates: integrity invariants including width 35, masked columns zero, clock columns zero, log-std byte-identical, no masked update
functional equivalence with the 25D subspace, BIT-EXACT
fit convergence: aggregate RMSE strictly lower than the initial one
ik_metrics_reported_without_invented_thr: per-joint RMSE and max absolute error

B1_declared_closed_loop_gates.ankle_note: q_min <= -0.03 rad is 19.3% of the reference plantarflexion depth. A minimum of -0.0099 rad DOES NOT satisfy it: -0.0099 > -0.03, and it is only 33% of the threshold in magnitude
B1_declared_closed_loop_gates.no_guard_relaxed: every threshold is the current v3 value or stricter; FSM v3, the morphology corridor, the contact model, the reward, the limiter, the governor and every safety guard are untouched

B2_markov_phase_declared_only.trigger: ONLY after the base gates pass
B2_markov_phase_declared_only.operation: remove the input mask; the ten first-layer columns are still exactly zero, so the transition is bit-exact
dataset: nominal anchors of the base actor labelled with the actor's OWN means
B2_markov_phase_declared_only.whole_mean_network_adaptation: NOT DECIDED NOW. It is preregistered at that stage, not here
B2_markov_phase_declared_only.sigma: OPEN. 0.005 is NOT assumed and must be MEASURED on the base actor before any stochastic recovery is collected

tooling.cross_platform: pathlib only, no shell invocation, no os-specific path handling
tooling.production_untouched: nothing outside this validation directory is modified; no C++, no SEA, no FSM, no morphology, no contact model, no reward, no guard

prohibitions: no gait clock in the actor
no import or execution of the superseded 25D branch
no S0D/S1A/REV4*/V2_* as parent or data
